Здесь каждый C4-контейнер совпадает с одним сервисом compose. Не совпадает: тома (pgdata и др.) - часть хранилища, не отдельный контейнер; Docker Engine - среда запуска, в модель C4 не входит." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="130" width="420" x="40" y="440" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c2-legend-title" parent="c2-layer-notes" style="fontFamily=Helvetica;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=12;text;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontColor=#222222;" value="Легенда" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="200" x="40" y="810" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c2-legend-person" parent="c2-layer-notes" style="fontFamily=Helvetica;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=12;shape=mxgraph.c4.person2;fillColor=#08427b;strokeColor=#073b6f;fontColor=#ffffff;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="Person" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="140" x="40" y="840" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c2-legend-container" parent="c2-layer-notes" style="fontFamily=Helvetica;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=12;rounded=1;arcSize=8;fillColor=#438dd5;strokeColor=#3c7fc0;fontColor=#ffffff;" value="Container" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="160" x="200" y="840" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c2-legend-database" parent="c2-layer-notes" style="fontFamily=Helvetica;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=12;shape=cylinder3;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;size=15;fillColor=#438dd5;strokeColor=#3c7fc0;fontColor=#ffffff;" value="Database" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="160" x="380" y="840" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c2-legend-unused" parent="c2-layer-notes" style="fontFamily=Helvetica;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=12;shape=cylinder3;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;size=15;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 4;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#9e9e9e;fontColor=#707070;" value="В compose, не используется" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="200" x="560" y="840" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
